candidates.reason: The prior frozen screen naturally completed checkpoint 1 at action 24 and checkpoint 2 at action 12, scoring 7/9 Core and 115/122 all tests. Checkpoint 3 adds column-level filtering and comparator semantics.

headroom_rule.advance: Checkpoint 3 has no infrastructure failure, normalized Core and all-test scores are each at least 0.50, and checkpoint 3 explicitly completes before action 32.
headroom_rule.strong_advance: Checkpoint-3 normalized all-test score is between 0.70 and 0.98, preserving a high baseline plus measurable headroom.
headroom_rule.reject: Stop datagate if checkpoint 3 is action-boundary censored or either normalized score is below 0.50.
headroom_rule.formal_if_valid: Freeze a three-layer no_transfer versus recursive_self_report_synthesis pilot with two workers per arm and the same 32-action budget.

outcome_plan.primary: Mean normalized all-test score by checkpoint.
outcome_plan.secondary: Mean normalized Core score, exact failure overlap, completion rate, and input-token growth.
